name: Forged in Ice
source:
After the fall of Aurelia, the Living Flame, the world has been locked in a frigid everfrost. The final embers are kept alive within the walls of Apricity, the last city, safeguarded by an order of powerful flame-wielding nobility: The Firecallers.

Beyond the city walls, the frostlands are harsh and unforgiving, but Herleva has resolved to forge her own path. She's a bit sharp around the edges, but she'll get you where you need to go. So when the young prince of the Firecallers requests your services, it’s up to you to cut a path through the ice.

[From [url=https://sarchalen.itch.io/forged-in-ice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自“活焰”奥蕾莉亚陨落之后，整个世界便陷入了刺骨严寒的永冬之中。最后的余烬保存在人类最后的都市“冬阳城”高墙之内，由一群操使强大火焰的贵族骑士团——“唤火者”严密守护。

城墙之外的冻土严酷无情，但赫尔莱娃早已下定决心靠自己的双手闯出一条生路。她说话做事虽有些棱角锋利，却定能带你抵达目的地。因此，当“唤火者”年轻的王子登门雇用你时，劈冰斩雪开辟前路的重任便落在了你的肩上。

[摘自[url=https://sarchalen.itch.io/forged-in-ice]itch.io[/url]]
